item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi mdel kha gsang ba'i tan tra phyi mdos bskang pa'i cha lags nub bdud kyi khram mdos
item.coloph: bdud kyi khram mdos bya ba/ phyi rabs kyi don du bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i(mkhas) / stong dmu tsha gyer med la gdams pa'o/ gsang ba'i brag la u tra sig phyi rabs skal ldan skyes bu la/ bka' rgyud bon gyi dngos grub bab/ 'gro ba'i don du cher 'phel nas/ g.yung drung bstan pa dar rgyas shog
